verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server that works with any MCP-compatible client (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, and others) and lets connected agents read and write across its products. Feature-flag management is explicitly exposed to MCP clients, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: It works with any MCP-compatible client, including [PostHog Desktop](https://posthog.com/desktop.md), Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, and Zed.
Once connected, your agent can read and write across PostHog's products.
Create, update, schedule, and clean up flags from any MCP client or AI editor.
